title: Managed Backup: incident registration
content:
For Managed Backup, the incident registration basis governs incident registration.

## Policy clauses

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external source reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and recorded availability percentage from the official operational report.

No customer statement substitutes for the report.

Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit rules exclude them.

Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external source reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and recorded availability percentage from the official operational report.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical incident report records scheduled maintenance. Its cause remains visible on the registered incident; registration itself changes neither the receivable nor the contract state.
